title: Genre popularity by plays
statementMd:
Number of plays per album genre, most first.

Expected columns: `genre`, `plays`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT al.genre, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM plays p JOIN tracks t ON t.id = p.track_id JOIN albums al ON al.id = t.album_id GROUP BY al.genre ORDER BY plays DESC;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
